home.heroSub: Certified C-Trainer. From your first shot to tournament play — structured, honest, and fun.

philo.title: Three pillars, one goal: you playing better.

1.title: Technique
1.body: Clean groundstrokes, bandeja, vibora, lob. Small adjustments with big impact — filmed, shown, corrected.

2.title: Tactics
2.body: Court positioning, building pressure, handling pressure. You learn to read what's happening — before it happens.

3.title: Mindset
3.body: Stay calm after mistakes. Communicate clearly with your partner. Play as a team, not as two players.

audience.title: No matter where you are — i'll meet you there.

1.title: Beginners
1.body: First shots, first rules, first victories. No pressure.

2.title: Advanced
2.body: You play regularly and want to break through the plateau. We'll find the leverage.

3.title: Tournament Players
3.body: Match preparation, video analysis, targeted training for your next level.

cta.title: Ready for your next hour?
cta.body: Write me on Instagram or Playtomic. I usually reply within hours.

about.title: Florian Molleker.
about.subtitle: C-Trainer for Padel. Player. Learner.
about.p1: I've been playing padel for over two years — started like many: through a friend, a first lesson, and then couldn't stop. Today I'm at Playtomic Level 5 and teach what I've learned through many hours, mistakes, and coaches.
about.p2: As a certified C-Trainer, I work structured: every hour has a focus, each focus builds on the last. No random ball hitting — but a clear red thread that you follow to improve.
about.p3: What's important to me: Honesty about realism. I won't tell you you'll be a pro in four weeks. I'll show you what you can work on today — and in four weeks you'll see the difference yourself.

certSection.title: DPV C-Trainer Licence.
certSection.body: Issued by the German Padel Association on 17.02.2026. The official coaching licence for structured padel coaching in Germany.

services.title: Transparent. Per Person. No Package Tricks.
services.subtitle: All prices per person and hour. More players — cheaper per person. Court rental not included.
services.ni1: Court rental (paid directly to the venue)

process.title: How it goes — from your first message to the last ball.

1.title: Tell me who's coming
1.body: Tell me how many people you'd like to train with — alone, in pairs, as a trio, or as a quartet.

2.title: We find a date
2.body: Together we find a time that works for you (and your fellow players).

3.title: You book the court
3.body: You book and pay for the court directly with the venue — so you keep full control over time and location.

4.title: We train
4.body: On the agreed date we meet on the court. I'll bring the balls — you bring yourself.

5.title: Your topic, your focus
5.body: Have something specific in mind — bandeja, return of serve, court position? Let me know, and I'll focus the entire session on exactly that.

contact.title: Write me.
contact.subtitle: The quickest way to reach me is Instagram or the in-app chat on Playtomic. Just drop your level, preferred location and weekdays — I usually reply the same day.
contact.locDetail: Exact venue is agreed after enquiry.
